source: Beginner short story written in spoken Israeli Hebrew by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: Today I go to the post office.
I need to send a letter.

sentences.ar: בפנים יש הרבה אנשים ותור ארוך.
sentences.en: Inside there are a lot of people and a long queue.
The man at the counter takes the letter.
I leave, glad that I'm finished.
